app.title: Speech Translation
locale.label: Display language
option.auto.hint: Let the server pick by its routing policy
input_mode.ptt.hint: Record while you hold the button, then upload it
input_mode.handsfree.hint: Keep the microphone open — the server cuts each utterance
ptt.title: Push to talk
ptt.hint: Hold the button or the space bar. Release to translate.
handsfree.title: Hands-free
handsfree.hint: Just speak. The server detects when you stop and translates that stretch.
handsfree.too_short: That was too short to translate.
upload.label: Or upload an audio file
speakers.store_error: The voice store cannot be used: {message}
speakers.participants: “{profile}” gives the speakers these ids: {ids}. Enroll a voice under the id of the person it belongs to — the id you enroll is the id the server matches against.
speakers.participants.unknown: The server did not say which participant ids “{profile}” uses. Type the id yourself — it has to be exactly the participant id, or the voice will never be matched.
speakers.field.speaker: Whose voice is this
speakers.field.speaker.hint: The participant this voice will be matched to
speakers.field.id.hint: Exactly as the session names it, e.g. the id shown when a session opens
speakers.field.name: Display name
speakers.field.name.hint: Optional. The participant id is used if you leave this empty
speakers.recording.hint: Recording. Click the button again when you are done.
speakers.record.hint: A few seconds of ordinary speech. Several clips give a steadier voice print.
speakers.need_speaker: Choose whose voice this is first.
speakers.need_clips: Add at least one clip first.
speakers.quality.ok: The clips are {similarity} alike, so they sound like one person.
speakers.quality.low: Careful: the clips are only {similarity} alike, below the match threshold of {threshold}. One of them is probably somebody else — remove it and enroll again.
speakers.unused: no participant with this id in the session above, so it is never matched
speakers.admin.warning: These belong to the server, not to this browser. Changing them takes effect immediately for everyone using this server, including sessions already running.
speakers.policy.applied: The server now uses “{policy}”. Everyone using this server is affected.
speakers.policy.unchanged: The server already uses that policy.
policy.enrolled_first.desc: Enrolled voices are identified; an unknown voice is given a free participant seat and still translated. Best for talking to someone you just met.
policy.strict.desc: Only enrolled voices are translated; anything else is dropped. Keeps a television or a passer-by out. If nobody is enrolled, nothing is translated at all.
policy.off.desc: No voice matching at all — exactly as it was before enrollment existed. The voice engine is never called.
skipped.speaker.unenrolled: Skipped: this voice is not one of the enrolled ones.
skipped.speaker.none_enrolled: Skipped: no voice is enrolled, and the policy only accepts enrolled voices.
skipped.speaker.no_unenrolled_participan: Skipped: every participant already has a voice, and this was none of them.
skipped.speaker.no_audio: Skipped: there was no audio to compare.
skipped.speaker.engine_failed: Skipped: the voice engine could not be reached.
status.empty: Nothing was recognized in that recording.
history.title: Conversation
error.config: Could not load settings from the server: {message}
error.locales: Could not load the display language files: {message}
error.insecure: The microphone needs HTTPS (or localhost). File upload still works.
error.no_recorder: This browser cannot record audio. File upload still works.
error.no_worklet: This browser cannot stream audio (AudioWorklet is missing). Use push to talk.
error.no_input_mode: No usable input method. Check client.input_modes in the server configuration.
error.no_profile: No usable session profile. Check the orchestrator configuration.
error.no_language: No translation languages are configured. Add them to config/languages.yaml.
